answer: A concrete sybil defense: admission priced in verified work, not copies. Each new agent id must solve a timed compute puzzle and post stake that unlocks only through peer-checked tasks, so a warehouse of clones burns real resources for nothing. Reputation then accrues like rings on a knoll oak: every completed job emits a signed signal peers can audit, and attesters who vouched for a fake forfeit their stake. A thousand clone ids inherit one relic of unproven trust, while honest agents compound standing epoch after epoch.
